problem: Held movement key autorepeat may rearm movement after a pause clears held input.
expected: Pause clears input; resume requires a fresh movement key press.
observed: Relay main clears held movement on pause.
Its document keydown movement handler does not reject repeat events.
A key held across pause/resume can produce repeat keydown without fresh keyup/press.
unknown: Whether the pause/resume usual-input browser scenario reproduces motion immediately.
